April 2026.topic: 🔴 MUST KNOW | Defence & Security | Operation Test April 2026 1
April 2026.text: Rapid revision point 1 for April 2026: Major induction and strategic deployment.

details.summary:
### 📌 What Happened
In April 2026, a major strategic development took place regarding the deployment of new assets.

### 🎯 Why It Matters
This significantly bolsters India's deterrence capabilities along the Northern borders.

### 🧠 Key Facts
- First deployment of the advanced MK-III variant.
- Jointly developed by DRDO and international partners.

### 🔗 Static GK Connection
DRDO was established in 1958. Its motto is 'Balasya Mulam Vigyanam'.

### ⚠️ Exam Trap
Do not confuse the MK-III variant with the naval MK-II variant which was inducted last year.

### 🎯 Possible Question Angle
UPSC may ask to identify the partner country involved in the joint development.
